description.text: The complete first supplied reference sheet fills the frame exactly as provided, with its full multi-panel layout, dividers, captions, background, subject placement and lighting held intact. Across the top panel, a rain-soaked elevated walkway at night stretches between metal railings, its wet paving reflecting blurred city lights; a single adult person with short dark hair, shaved sides and a small topknot stands centered in a black collared jacket, dark shirt, black trousers and black combat boots, head turned slightly aside under cool blue rain and warm amber streetlights. In the middle row, three full-body turnaround views on a plain dark gray studio backdrop show the same person upright with arms relaxed at the sides, labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and BACK. Along the bottom row, four close-up panels show the neutral direct gaze of the face, the zippered jacket collar with its rectangular buckle and strap, the bare hands with dark smudges across the knuckles, and the scuffed lace-up boots, labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS and BOOTS. The whole sheet remains uncropped and page-like, every panel and existing label staying in place while only the falling rain in the top panel drifts in fine streaks.
Steady rain taps the wet walkway and a distant city hum sits low under it.
The complete first reference sheet fills the frame, all panels, dividers and captions intact.
Only the falling rain in the top hero panel drifts in fine streaks while every figure and label stays fixed.

A slow visual dissolve carries the first sheet away as the second supplied reference sheet rises through it, both images briefly sharing the frame before the second becomes fully opaque. The arriving sheet shows its complete multi-panel layout, dividers, captions, background, creature placement and lighting. In the large top panel, a massive black dragon with swept-back pale ivory horns, a spiked crest and ridged neck, long spiked tail and raised membranous wings stands forward-leaning on jagged black rock in a volcanic landscape; glowing orange lava cracks, dark smoke, wet reflective ground and a near-black backdrop surround it while its head lowers toward the ground, jaw slightly open, clawed feet planted. The middle row presents FRONT, SIDE PROFILE and REAR turnaround panels on a plain near-black studio backdrop. The bottom row presents HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT and SCALE DETAIL panels, showing a small amber eye and pale horns, dark leathery wing membrane with radial struts, thick scaled toes with curved claws, and overlapping ridged scales with blue-green sheen. Warm orange lava glow and soft directional modeling light define the sheet, and all existing lettering remains intact as the final image resolves exactly to the complete supplied second picture.
The first sheet begins to thin and the second sheet starts to rise through it.
The rain and city hum soften as a low rumbling drone enters.
Both sheets are visible at once, the first fading over the second, with dividers and labels doubled but still legible.
The second sheet is fully opaque, its complete layout and lettering intact at the final image.

soundscape: Steady rain on the wet walkway and a distant city hum, joined by a low volcanic rumble as the second sheet arrives.
music: A slow, low ambient score with a sustained drone that swells through the dissolve and settles under the final sheet.
